metadata.caption: Jason King, Dean of the USC Thornton School of Music, moderating "Vibe Revived: Reflections from Vibe Magazine's Trailblazing Writers and Editors", the closing panel of the 2025 Pop Conference at University of Southern California, Los Angeles, California. The panel, which took place at Newman Recital Hall on the USC campus, was also the culmination of a series of events at USC organized by King and dedicated to the late Quincy Jones; Jones founded Vibe, a Time, Inc. publication.

metadata.author: Onlymyself65536
metadata.caption: ​豆花妹《情豆花開》台中簽唱會

biography.excerpt: 蔡黃汝（1987年11月15日—），藝名豆花妹，臺灣女藝人，歌手、演員、主持人，出生於臺灣台北縣泰山鄉（今新北市泰山區），醒吾技術學院行銷與流通管理系畢業。2021年開始擔任飢餓遊戲主持人，並於2026年榮獲第61屆金鐘獎實境節目主持人獎。
